title: The Oath of Office
description: Republic Square. The Constitution. Sixty thousand people in the cold. The swearing-in ceremony marks the first democratic transfer of power in twenty-nine years. Your inaugural address will define the tone of your government.

title: The Full Picture
description: Vyktor has convened a situation room briefing with Oberlin and Colonel Dusek. Four crises on the table simultaneously: the fiscal deficit, the BNI, Tyvaren troop movements, and the constitutional reform timeline. He needs to know your priority.

title: Review the Ledger
description: Chief of Staff Reznik has prepared a full accounting of the national finances — the real figures, not what was reported publicly under Halvek. The numbers require your immediate attention.

title: The Bureau's Shadow
description: Minister Oberlin has obtained documents indicating the Bureau of National Integrity is still running active surveillance operations against journalists and civil society. She is requesting an immediate meeting.

title: Parliamentary Caucus
description: Your Civic Renewal bloc is anxious about the pace of constitutional reform. Professor Theron has called a caucus briefing. Thirty-one MPs are waiting for direction.

title: A Pastoral Invitation
description: Archbishop Renek has extended a dinner invitation to the Cathedral residence. His office describes it as a pastoral visit. It is a negotiation.

title: An Evening at Home
description: Jonas has asked you to come home for dinner. Tomas had a difficult day at school. Liora has questions. The house has been empty most of the week.

title: Fiscal Year Budget Review
description: Reznik has prepared the full national accounts. Revenue is 380M ₭. Expenditure is 445M ₭. The 65M ₭ annual deficit must be addressed — or deliberately maintained. This is your signature on the Republic's finances.
